name: leo-mod-health-doubler
description: Every 1000 blocks you mine your health doubles — Leo's third Minecraft Bedrock add-on

scripts.version: node tools/sync-version.mjs && git add pack/manifest.json resource_pack/manifest.json
scripts.build: npm run check && node tools/sync-version.mjs && esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --format=esm --external:@minecraft/server --outfile=pack/scripts/main.js
